title: Peanut Butter Whey Protein Cookie

ingredients.as_written: 2 tsp stevia/monkfruit extract/ honey (honey will shoot up calories so try using zero calorie alternatives)
2 spoons of Whey Protein (I am using Vanilla flavor - If your protein powder is too sweet, you can reduce quantity of sweetner) (9g)

steps: Mix the peanut butter, sweetner of choice and milk until it comes together.
Now add the powdered oats, protein powder and baking soda.
Mix it well and form a nice round cookie dough ball. If the mixture appears too crumbly and difficult to bind, add one more spoon of milk and a little bit of peanut butter.
Let it rest in the fridge for 15 minutes.
You can make this in a preheated airfryer/oven. Bake or airfry this at 180 degrees for 15-18 mins.

Imp tip: Flatten it little before before you put it for baking. In the mid, just take the cookie out once and flatten a bit with the back of the glass and repeat the same after 10 mins. It will develop a few cracks when you flatten it, but that makes it crispy and crumbly.
assumptions: The ingredient list also names honey as an alternative or note; it isn’t listed separately.

flags.note: No protein source reaches 35 % of the protein (CONTEXT §4), so it has no main protein.
